snippet.title: Inkblood | Demo trailer | Play now on Steam
snippet.description:
Play the demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4475210/Inkblood_Demo/

Inkblood is a detective game where you follow a trail of death and try to find out what a bizarre cult is planning in the charming village of Inqburg. There are even some really tasty mushrooms!

Try the first three cases of this occult narrative experience thanks to the demo now available on Steam!
